No product code was modified (git status shows only src/persist.mjs and src/store.mjs modified by dependency tasks T3/T4/T5; test/ files are mine). Final verification against the real tree: npm test => 19/19 pass (18 new + 1 pre-existing app test), npm run build clean, npm run lint clean. All scratch/baseline files were removed; test/ contains only app.test.mjs and persist.test.mjs. fixTaskType: NONE (no product defect found; the earlier verification red-light failure was an artifact of the implementation already having landed before this test task ran, not a product bug).
